_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#10. On this build the binary's own schema says SOLID owns exactly nine 3D cell types — HEX8 HEX18 HEX20 HEX27 TET4 TET10 WEDGE6 PYRAMID5 NURBS27 — and no 2D cell (SCHEMA_SOLID_OWNS_QUAD4=0), while WALL owns QUAD4 (SCHEMA_WALL_OWNS_QUAD4=1) with the keyword set MAT/KINEM/EAS/THICK/STRESS_STRAIN/GP. The same 4-node 2D deck is then run three ways: 'WALL QUAD4 ... KINEM linear EAS none THICK 1.0 STRESS_STRAIN plane_strain GP 2 2' exits 0 at dispy 4.33333333333345890e-03 (pinned at TOLERANCE 1e-12); 'SOLID QUAD4' exits 1 with "Element 'SOLID' does not seem to know cell type 'quad4'." from core/fem/src/general/element/4C_fem_general_element_definition.cpp line 29, with the cell type echoed in lowercase; an unregistered name gives a DIFFERENT message from a different file, "Unknown type 'BOGUSELE' of finite element" from core/comm/src/4C_comm_parobjectfactory.cpp line 153, and the SOLID arm never produces it (SOLID_ARM_SAID_UNKNOWN_TYPE=0). Note the quotes in that template — an unquoted grep for it finds nothing. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Element 'SOLID' does not seem to know cell type 'quad4'.
SCHEMA_SOLID_CELLS=HEX8 HEX18 HEX20 HEX27 TET4 TET10 WEDGE6 PYRAMID5 NURBS27

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the SOLID arm: write the element type that owns QUAD4 on this build. The cell-type diagnostic vanishes and the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: mk "1 SOLID QUAD4 1 2 3 4 MAT 1 KINEM linear" "$TMP/solid.yaml"
_mutation.to: mk "1 WALL QUAD4 1 2 3 4 MAT 1 KINEM linear EAS none THICK 1.0 STRESS_STRAIN plane_strain GP 2 2" "$TMP/solid.yaml"

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the unregistered-type arm: name a type the factory knows. The unknown-type diagnostic vanishes and the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: mk "1 BOGUSELE QUAD4 1 2 3 4 MAT 1 KINEM linear" "$TMP/bogus.yaml"
_mutation.to: mk "1 WALL QUAD4 1 2 3 4 MAT 1 KINEM linear EAS none THICK 1.0 STRESS_STRAIN plane_strain GP 2 2" "$TMP/bogus.yaml"
